title: docs(metadata-core): item-key-discriminators cites the email-template locale contract instead of a stale "best match" quote
body:
Fixes #19592

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The module docblock of `packages/metadata-core/src/item-key-discriminators.ts` put a sentence inside quotation marks and attributed it to `EmailTemplateDefinitionSchema` (`packages/spec/src/system/email-template.zod.ts`). The sentence said the service "picks the best match for the recipient's locale, falling back to `en-US`". That sentence occurs nowhere in `packages/spec/src`. It also says the opposite of the contract: `SendTemplateInput.template` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts` says there is no "best match" and no language-subtag folding, and that the locale row is resolved by the exact ladder documented on `locale`.

The docblock now:

- cites `EmailTemplateDefinitionSchema` by file and symbol for the identity fact (its `locale` key is the second half of the bundle key) instead of quoting it;
- says that resolution is exact, and cites `SendTemplateInput.template` for the rule that there is no best match and no subtag folding;
- names `SendTemplateInput.locale` as the ladder of record and summarises it outside quotation marks: the named tag matched exactly, then the literal `en-US`, then, only for a call that named no locale and only when the bundle has no `en-US` row, the bundle's lowest locale tag;
- keeps its one other quotation, "is resolved by `(name, locale)`" from the schema header. That text still exists verbatim (it wraps over `email-template.zod.ts` lines 19-20).

Only prose changed. No code, type, export or accept set moves. `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`, `readDiscriminatorValue`, `itemDiscriminator` and the `en-US` canonical are untouched.

## Premise check (base 4112752ec3)

I checked the premise with a probe that handles line wrapping. It strips comment leaders and string-concat joins, joins lines, and collapses whitespace, over the 1532 files of `packages/spec/src`:

| needle | files |
|---|---|
| `picks the best match` | 0 |
| `best match for the recipient's locale` | 0 |
| `the service picks` | 0 |
| ``falling back to `en-US` `` | 0 |
| control: `There is no "best match" and no language-subtag folding` (wraps over `email-service.ts:153-155`) | 1 (`contracts/email-service.ts`) |
| control: ``a single named template is resolved by `(name, locale)` `` (wraps over `email-template.zod.ts:19-20`) | 1 (`system/email-template.zod.ts`) |

A single-line `git grep -F` of the whole contract sentence finds 0 files, because the sentence wraps over three lines. That is why the probe has to handle line wrapping: a negative from a single-line grep proves nothing here. The runtime matches the contract. In `@objectstack/plugin-email`, `resolveAndRenderTemplate` and `createSysEmailTemplateLoader` implement exactly the three-rung ladder and contain no folding branch.

## Synonym sweep (dispatch item A3)

This sweep uses the same wrap-handling probe, over the non-test sources and docs of `packages/**` at 4112752ec3. It excludes `*.test.*`, `*.spec.*`, `__tests__/`, `test(s)/`, `fixtures/`, `dist/` and `CHANGELOG.md`.

- Pass 1: 16 synonym patterns over 2698 files, for example best/closest/nearest match or locale, "picks the best", recipient's locale, falls/falling back to en, subtag folding, language-only prefix, locale negotiation. It produced 85 hit lines, and I read all of them in context.
- Pass 2: broader patterns (best-fit, closest, nearest, appropriate or suitable locale, matching locale, approximate, negotiat, picks a locale/row, fall back to/through/on, fallback chain) over the 105 files whose text mentions email templates. It produced 240 hit lines. I read the 52 high-signal ones and the 32 fall-back or recipient hits that have locale context.

The target is the only file that affirms a best, closest or nearest resolution for email templates. Every email-template hit:

| file:line | phrase | reading |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/metadata-core/src/item-key-discriminators.ts:7-10` | "picks the best match for the recipient's locale, falling back to `en-US`" | **affirms**, contradicts the contract; fixed in this PR |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts:24-30` | quotes the old "picks the best match for the recipient's locale" / "picks the best-matching locale" | historical quote, framed as the false claim that was corrected; accurate |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts:17-19` | quotes "Falls back to `'en-US'`" and "matches `(name, locale)` **exactly**" | both quotes exist verbatim (`email-service.ts:163`, `email-template.zod.ts:113-114`); accurate |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts:459,467-469,1402` | falls back to `en-US`; no "best match" and no language-subtag folding | denies best match / states rung 2; accurate |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts:680` | "the ladder silently falls back to the `en-US` body" | rung 2; accurate |
| `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-email-template.object.ts:10-12` | NO language-subtag folding … no "best match" | denies; accurate |
| `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-template.object.ts:66` | "neither side picks a 'best-matching' locale" | denies; accurate |
| `packages/services/service-messaging/src/email-channel.ts:152,178,318` | `sendTemplate` picks the `(name, recipient locale)` row with its documented en-US ladder | the caller chooses the locale; accurate |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:1132-1154` | quotes "no language-only prefix matching" | quote exists (`email-service.ts:168`); the caller promotes the tag before `sendTemplate`; accurate |
| `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:3317,3418-3419` | no language-subtag folding | denies; accurate |
| `packages/spec/src/system/email-template.zod.ts:32,117,147` | no language-subtag folding | denies; accurate |
| `packages/spec/liveness/email_template.json:27` | "the recipient's locale picks between them" | selects between rows by exact match; accurate |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts:153` | the contract sentence | the authority |

The other hits (for example `marketplace/package-l10n.ts`, `system/doc.zod.ts`, `shared/suggestions.zod.ts`, `objectql` engine locale negotiation, `rest-server` Accept-Language) are about other subsystems. None of them makes a claim about email-template resolution.

Supplemental (outside the dispatched scope, read-only): I ran the same pass-1 probe over `content/docs`, `skills`, `examples`, `docs` and `apps` (890 files). It found 3 hits, and none affirms a best match.

## Changeset measurement: the old text ships

`@objectstack/metadata-core` is public (17.4.0 on npm) and `files` is `["dist"]`. I built it at base with `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/metadata-core...` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0) and grepped every dist file:

| phrase | at base | after this PR (abb129b73e) |
|---|---|---|
| `picks the best match` | `index.d.ts` 1, `index.d.cts` 1 (0 in `.js`/`.cjs`) | 0 in all 12 dist files |
| `That resolution is exact.` (new) | — | `index.d.ts` 1, `index.d.cts` 1 |
| control `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS` | 3 each in `index.js`, `index.cjs`, `index.d.ts`, `index.d.cts` | unchanged |
| control, the module's own heading `i18n bundles — metadata types whose IDENTITY is a pair` | `index.d.ts` 1, `index.d.cts` 1 | unchanged |

The old sentence shipped in the published declaration files, so this PR carries a `patch` changeset (`.changeset/19592-item-key-discriminator-stale-quote.md`) and not `skip-changeset`.

## Verification (head abb129b73e)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (under the verify lock): 16 files, 285 tests passed; VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core run typecheck` (both `tsc --noEmit` programs): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 52 commands. I ran all 52 and captured each exit code before any pipe. 50 exited 0 and 2 exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package's `dist`, and `check:lean-entry-closure` needs `objectql`'s `dist`). `--ran` reconciliation: "52 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 50 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED", 0 UNRUN, exit 0.
- Why those two NOT MEASURED do not affect this PR: both judge the JavaScript that gets loaded. I built base 4112752ec3 in a throwaway comparison worktree, and `cmp` reports `index.js`, `index.cjs`, `testing.js` and `chunk-GUYCZEC2.js` byte-identical to this head (exit 0 each). The control `index.js.map` differs (exit 1), so the comparison can detect a change. CI runs both gates on a full build.
- The derivation flagged 4 roster families whose roster sits in a directory this diff touches: `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`. All exit 0.
- Narrowed lint, measured over the whole diff: eslint's own resolved config for `item-key-discriminators.ts` has only `ecmaVersion`/`sourceType` parser options, with no `project` and no `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot change the verdict for any untouched file. `--format json` linted 1 file with 0 errors and 0 warnings. The changeset `.md` is outside eslint's population ("File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied").

## Acceptance notes

- The docblock cites the spec rather than quoting it. Quoting is what stranded this sentence: the spec was reworded and nothing flagged the copy. The one remaining quotation is a verbatim substring of the current schema header.
- The `canonical` paragraph further down the file ("mirrors the schema's own `locale` default and `sendTemplate`'s documented fallback") is accurate against `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_FLOOR_LOCALE` and rung 2, and is untouched.
